phase_1.title: Phase 1 · Saiga-12K Trigger Release & Ignition Drive
phase_1.description: Pulling the trigger disengages the sear, freeing the spring-driven hammer or striker to impact the 12 Gauge (76mm / 3" Magnum) primer.

phase_2.title: Phase 2 · 74 MPa Chamber Pressure Rise
phase_2.description: The propellant charge ignites inside the locked chamber, driving peak pressure to 74 MPa while sealing the cartridge case against the breech.

phase_3.title: Phase 3 · 430 mm Barrel Engraving & Acceleration
phase_3.description: The projectile engages the smooth bore and accelerates to 405 m/s (3150 J).

phase_4.title: Phase 4 · Long-Stroke Unlock & Operating Impulse
phase_4.description: Once chamber pressure decays safely, long-stroke gas piston drives carrier free-travel before cam-rotating the locking bolt.

phase_5.title: Phase 5 · Spent Case Extraction & Ejection
phase_5.description: The extractor pulls the fired brass clear of the chamber and pivots it out the ejection port while the recoil spring compresses.

phase_6.title: Phase 6 · Next-Round Stripping & Breech Lockup
phase_6.description: Driven forward by the recoil spring, the breech strips the next round from the 8-round supply and locks solidly into battery.

phase_7.title: Phase 7 · Disconnector Handoff & Sear Reset
phase_7.description: Releasing the trigger hands control cleanly back to the primary sear, leaving the Saiga-12K staged for its 240 RPM (rapid box-fed semi-auto) cadence.

zh.headline: 俄罗斯赛加-12K 卡拉什尼科夫霰弹枪：1997 年机械传奇与工程剖析
zh.deck: 俄罗斯赛加-12K 将 AK-74M 经典冲压机匣、长行程导气活塞与双突笋回转枪机整体等比放大至 12 号口径，搭配两档旋转导气阀与 8 发可拆卸直弹匣，让近战霰弹枪拥有与突击步枪同等迅捷的换弹速度。 本馆以 1:1 真实工程比例重现其 20 大核心构件与完整工作循环。

acts.title: 时代召唤与研发立项：Saiga-12K 的诞生背景
paragraphs: 1997 年问世的 俄罗斯赛加-12K 卡拉什尼科夫霰弹枪 由俄罗斯伊热夫斯克机械制造厂（Kalashnikov Concern）主导研制，定位为经典的AK 构型弹匣式半自动霰弹枪。赛加-12 系列于 1990 年代末由伊热夫斯克厂研发，其后续警用/竞赛衍生型在 IPSC 实用射击公开组与多国反恐部队中风靡全球。
俄罗斯赛加-12K 将 AK-74M 经典冲压机匣、长行程导气活塞与双突笋回转枪机整体等比放大至 12 号口径，搭配两档旋转导气阀与 8 发可拆卸直弹匣，让近战霰弹枪拥有与突击步枪同等迅捷的换弹速度。 整件装备总长 910 mm（侧折托 670 mm）、空重 3.5 kg，成为同期霰弹枪领域最具辨识度的里程碑之一。
acts.audioScript: 第一幕，时代起源。1997 年，俄罗斯伊热夫斯克机械制造厂（Kalashnikov Concern）推出了划时代的俄罗斯赛加-12K 卡拉什尼科夫霰弹枪。赛加-12 系列于 1990 年代末由伊热夫斯克厂研发，其后续警用/竞赛衍生型在 IPSC 实用射击公开组与多国反恐部队中风靡全球。 它的核心设计聚焦于血统纯正的 AK 冲压机匣与强化回转闭锁枪机，极寒与泥浆环境高度可靠，奠定了其在霰弹枪发展史中的经典地位。
acts.focusPartLabel: 主体机匣与闭锁承力框架

acts.title: 核心机械构造与闭锁奥秘
paragraphs: 俄罗斯赛加-12K 卡拉什尼科夫霰弹枪 的机械灵魂在于其「AK 长行程活塞回转双突笋闭锁 · 两档导气调节阀 · 可拆直弹匣」结构体系。在发射工作循环中，长行程导气活塞带动枪机框完成自由行程并驱动旋转闭锁解锁，将高压能量精确约束于承力框架之内。
制造工艺方面，关键承力件采用硬质阳极氧化铝合金、氮化钢与高强度聚合物精加工而成。前置两档旋钮式导气调节阀（标准弹 / 3 英寸马格南重弹），在严苛实战条件下依然保持顺畅节拍与长期尺寸稳定性。
acts.audioScript: 第二幕，核心机械原理。俄罗斯赛加-12K 卡拉什尼科夫霰弹枪 采用AK 长行程活塞回转双突笋闭锁 · 两档导气调节阀 · 可拆直弹匣。在每个击发周期中，长行程导气活塞带动枪机框完成自由行程并驱动旋转闭锁解锁。借助硬质阳极氧化铝合金、氮化钢与高强度聚合物工艺与高强度配合，实现了前置两档旋钮式导气调节阀（标准弹 / 3 英寸马格南重弹）。
acts.focusPartLabel: 高强度闭锁枪机头与抽壳钩

acts.title: 弹道性能、内膛工艺与实战效能
paragraphs: 该平台配用 12 Gauge (76mm / 3" Magnum) 弹药规格与 430 mm（16.9 in 镀铬滑膛身管 · 外螺纹膛口），最高工作膛压约 74 MPa，可赋予弹头 405 m/s 的出膛初速与 3,150 J 动能，有效作用距离达 50 米。
内膛技术特点方面，18.5 mm 镀铬滑膛身管，支持外接“悖论”膛线喉缩器发射高精度独头弹。同时，可拆卸直弹匣彻底取代逐发塞填管状弹仓，战术换弹耗时缩减 70%，令其在 240 发/分（半自动快速换匣） 的节奏下兼具精准控制与可靠输出。
acts.audioScript: 第三幕，弹道与实战表现。配备 430 毫米身管与 12 Gauge (76mm / 3" Magnum) 口径，俄罗斯赛加-12K 卡拉什尼科夫霰弹枪 实现了每秒 405 米的初速与 50 米有效射程。18.5 mm 镀铬滑膛身管，支持外接“悖论”膛线喉缩器发射高精度独头弹，展现了卓越的工程平衡。

acts.title: 人机工效、供弹哲学与百年遗产
paragraphs: 围绕 8 发容量的8 发可拆式双排弹匣壳体与 34 mm 膛轴设计，俄罗斯赛加-12K 卡拉什尼科夫霰弹枪 将单发后坐冲量控制在 22.6 N·s 水平。机匣左侧燕尾槽直装俄式红点镜，聚合护木配侧折聚合物枪托。
如今在数字兵器库 3D 百年展厅（BAY-78）中，您可以随时通过三轴剖视、100% 爆炸视图与实时运动学滑块，零距离拆解这座跨越时代的机械工程杰作。
acts.audioScript: 第四幕，百年遗产。凭借 8 发容量的8 发可拆式双排弹匣壳体与出色的整体工效，机匣左侧燕尾槽直装俄式红点镜，聚合护木配侧折聚合物枪托。欢迎在 BAY-78 展位亲手切开剖面、逐件拆解，感受 俄罗斯赛加-12K 卡拉什尼科夫霰弹枪 的机械魅力。

en.deck: Scaling the AK-74M stamped receiver, long-stroke gas piston, and dual-lug rotating bolt up to 12-gauge magnum, the Russian Saiga-12K combines a two-position gas regulator with detachable 8-round box magazines for assault-rifle reload speed. acts.title: Origins & Operational Mandate of the Saiga-12K
paragraphs: Introduced in 1997 by Izhmash / Kalashnikov Concern in Russia, the Izhmash Saiga-12K Combat Shotgun emerged as a defining AK-Pattern Box-Fed Semi-Auto Shotgun. Developed by Izhmash in the late 1990s, the Saiga-12 family revolutionized both IPSC Open-division competition and law-enforcement tactical breaching worldwide.

Scaling the AK-74M stamped receiver, long-stroke gas piston, and dual-lug rotating bolt up to 12-gauge magnum, the Russian Saiga-12K combines a two-position gas regulator with detachable 8-round box magazines for assault-rifle reload speed. Measuring 910 mm (670 mm folded) at an unloaded weight of 3.5 kg, it reshaped expectations across the Combat Shotgun class.
acts.audioScript: Act One: Historical Origins. In 1997, Izhmash / Kalashnikov Concern of Russia introduced the Izhmash Saiga-12K Combat Shotgun. Developed by Izhmash in the late 1990s, the Saiga-12 family revolutionized both IPSC Open-division competition and law-enforcement tactical breaching worldwide. Anchored by its hallmark design trait — True Kalashnikov stamped receiver and reinforced rotating bolt excel in mud and ice — it quickly established an enduring engineering benchmark.

acts.title: Core Operating Architecture & Lockup Mechanics
paragraphs: At the mechanical heart of the Izhmash Saiga-12K Combat Shotgun sits its AK Long-Stroke Piston Rotating Bolt · Two-Position Gas Regulator · Box Magazine. Throughout every firing cycle, long-stroke gas piston drives carrier free-travel before cam-rotating the locking bolt, containing 74 MPa of operating pressure safely.

Constructed in hard-coat anodized aluminum, nitrided steel, and reinforced polymer, the assembly achieves durable field tolerances. Notably, Two-position front gas regulator balances light target loads and 3-inch magnums, sustaining dependable operation under severe environmental stress.
acts.audioScript: Act Two: Core Mechanical Architecture. The Izhmash Saiga-12K Combat Shotgun relies on AK Long-Stroke Piston Rotating Bolt · Two-Position Gas Regulator · Box Magazine. During each cycle, long-stroke gas piston drives carrier free-travel before cam-rotating the locking bolt. Machined from hard-coat anodized aluminum, nitrided steel, and reinforced polymer, it delivers standout engineering reliability: Two-position front gas regulator balances light target loads and 3-inch magnums.

acts.title: Ballistic Performance, Bore Craft & Range Reach
paragraphs: Chambered for 12 Gauge (76mm / 3" Magnum) with 430 mm (16.9 in Chrome-Lined Smoothbore · Threaded Muzzle), the Izhmash Saiga-12K Combat Shotgun develops 405 m/s muzzle velocity and 3,150 J of kinetic energy for effective engagement out to 50 meters.

Internally, 18.5 mm chrome-lined smoothbore accepting rifled Paradox chokes for precision slugs. Combined with its 240 RPM (rapid box-fed semi-auto) tempo, Detachable box magazines slash reload time compared to single-shell tubular tubes, delivering disciplined accuracy across demanding field conditions.
acts.audioScript: Act Three: Ballistic Performance. Driving 12 Gauge (76mm / 3" Magnum) through its 430 millimeter bore, the Izhmash Saiga-12K Combat Shotgun achieves 405 meters per second and 50 meters of effective reach. 18.5 mm chrome-lined smoothbore accepting rifled Paradox chokes for precision slugs.

acts.title: Feed Philosophy, Ergonomics & Centennial Legacy
paragraphs: Fed by a 8-round 8-round detachable magazine body with a 34 mm bore-axis height, the platform manages 22.6 N-s of recoil impulse cleanly. Side dovetail optic rail and left-folding polymer stock mirror AK-74M ergonomics.
Now archived in Digital Armory 3D Centennial Gallery (BAY-78), all 20 interactive assemblies can be sectioned live along three axes, exploded to 100%, and inspected part by part.

Pairing its 8-round 8-round detachable magazine body with disciplined recoil geometry, Side dovetail optic rail and left-folding polymer stock mirror AK-74M ergonomics. Explore BAY-78 in live section cut and exploded disassembly to study every working link of the Izhmash Saiga-12K Combat Shotgun.
